protocol: fresh Codex context with only Convertigo Flow MCP and headless Playwright

timing.interpretation: The authoring model hit capacity immediately after starting the build. A measured validation-only resume rebuilt and tested the unchanged project. Active agent time was 10m21s; the interruption and restart make this an honest functional benchmark but not a clean end-to-end timing baseline.

toolingFindings.finding: Complete Flow Svelte source authoring still cannot obtain and apply all unambiguous schema-backed bindings in one pass.
toolingFindings.impact: The structure was written with one source call, but the agent still made 13 tree inspections and 7 leaf mutations for the ForEach and six descendant fields.
toolingFindings.next: Expose a composed binding plan from code-check or flow-app-progress and accept one ordered mutation batch, while retaining picker-derived descriptors.

toolingFindings.finding: flow-output-schema adopt executed after code-promote left a new dirty working revision.
toolingFindings.impact: A later runtime check reported unsaved:true and required a second promotion after validation.
toolingFindings.next: Make adopt persist atomically or return the new revision and an explicit mandatory promote call.

toolingFindings.finding: frontend-svelte-code-check accepted unknown Status properties loadingLabel and successLabel.
toolingFindings.impact: The application built without the intended status labels, so intuitive source can silently lose behavior.
toolingFindings.next: Validate block properties against the palette schema and return canonical loadingText/successText diagnostics or fixes.

toolingFindings.finding: The default skill is 683 lines and the fresh agent read it in full, then listed resources and read three guides.
toolingFindings.impact: The first Flow MCP call occurred about 47 seconds after launch and context volume was unnecessarily high.
toolingFindings.next: Keep a short executable default workflow in SKILL.md and move detailed reference material behind focused resources.

toolingFindings.finding: The built application requests /favicon.ico and receives 404.
toolingFindings.impact: Browser validation reports one unrelated console error.
toolingFindings.next: Generate a default favicon or suppress the request in the frontend template.
